findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_field_notes, get_quote_request_checklist, request_quote, get_quote_status · Private data: get_company_profile · Public sink: estimate_design_fee, get_quote_request_checklist, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_field_notes, get_quote_request_checklist, request_quote, get_quote_status · Private data: get_company_profile · Public sink: estimate_design_fee, get_quote_request_checklist, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
